title: Meta Open-Sources 30B-Parameter Muse Glimmer for Local AI Agent on Consumer Hardware
excerpt: Meta released the open-source model Muse Glimmer on August 10, aimed at supporting local AI agents on consumer-grade hardware, representing the latest implement
content_html:
Meta released the open-source model Muse Glimmer on August 10, aimed at supporting local AI agents on consumer-grade hardware, representing the latest implementation of its "Personal Superintelligence" vision. The model has 30 billion parameters and is essentially an open version of Meta's closed model Muse Spark, released in April this year. The model weights are released under the Apache 2.0 license, allowing developers to download, modify, and fine-tune them.

Muse Glimmer is designed for multi-step agent tasks, capable of calling tools, writing and debugging code, handling files and screenshots, and executing extended workflows. The model supports text and images, and its training covers over 100 languages. It can run locally on a Mac or PC with a single consumer-grade GPU, and is designed to be "always-on," working even without an internet connection.

Meta envisions its use in managing schedules, writing emails, organizing files, and other tasks that require processing large amounts of personal data. By processing information locally, it reduces the need to upload data to the cloud, exploring more privacy-focused personal AI assistants.

This approach aligns with Zuckerberg's previous "Personal Superintelligence" concept. In a new public letter released on August 10, he stated that widespread access to superintelligence could empower individuals and hopes that related tools will eventually be available for free or at an affordable price. However, Meta still differentiates between open and closed models: the more powerful Muse Spark remains closed, while Glimmer allows users to download and run it locally, showing its layered strategy between AI openness and model control.

content_html_zh:
Meta于8月10日发布了开源模型Muse Glimmer，旨在支持消费级硬件上的本地AI代理，代表其“个人超级智能”愿景的最新实现。 该模型拥有 300 亿个参数，本质上是今年 4 月发布的 Meta 封闭模型 Muse Spark 的开放版本。 模型权重在 Apache 2.0 许可证下发布，允许开发人员下载、修改和微调。

Muse Glimmer 专为多步骤代理任务而设计，能够调用工具、编写和调试代码、处理文件和屏幕截图以及执行扩展工作流程。 该模型支持文本和图像，其训练涵盖 100 多种语言。 它可以在具有单个消费级 GPU 的 Mac 或 PC 上本地运行，并且被设计为“永远在线”，即使没有互联网连接也能工作。

Meta 设想将其用于管理日程、撰写电子邮件、组织文件以及其他需要处理大量个人数据的任务。 通过在本地处理信息，它减少了将数据上传到云端的需要，探索更多注重隐私的个人人工智能助理。

这种方法与扎克伯格之前的“个人超级智能”概念相一致。 在 8 月 10 日发布的一封新公开信中，他表示，广泛使用超级智能可以赋予个人权力，并希望相关工具最终能够免费或以实惠的价格提供。 不过，Meta 仍然区分了开放和封闭模型：功能更强大的 Muse Spark 仍然是封闭的，而 Glimmer 则允许用户在本地下载并运行，展现了其在 AI 开放和模型控制之间的分层策略。
